newsitem.title: USA: Southland sees difficult comparisons until late Q3.
newsitem.headline: Southland sees difficult comparisons until late Q3.

text.p: Southland Corp said Monday it will face "difficult" comparisons with last years's results until late in the third quarter.
The company said its second quarter earnings decline was primarily the result of comparison against an unusually favorable gasoline market in 1996.
It said that while recent retail gasoline conditions have shown some signs of improvement, it will be going against difficult comparisons to last year until late in the third quarter.
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.06 compared with $0.07, or net income of $25.6 million compared with $30.3 million.
Revenues were $1.80 million compared with $1.81 million.
